description: Starter podcast set for language learners, grouped by listening difficulty. Every show here is restricted to those with transcripts embedded directly in the RSS feed (Podcasting 2.0 <podcast:transcript> tag), so the ingestion pipeline can pull transcripts without scraping or running speech-to-text. All are ordinary general-interest podcasts (not ESL-specific content).

difficultyLevels.easy: Single narrator or narrator-led scripted format, deliberate pace, standard accent, low idiom/slang density.
difficultyLevels.intermediate: Two hosts, natural conversational pace, some idiom/slang, occasional tangents or domain-specific vocabulary.
difficultyLevels.hard: Multiple speakers (hosts + rotating guests), fast native pace, heavy slang/pop-culture references, frequent crosstalk.

transcriptSourceNote: All shows below are produced/distributed via iHeartPodcasts and hosted on Omny Studio, which auto-generates per-episode transcripts and exposes them in the RSS feed as <podcast:transcript> entries in SubRip (.srt), WebVTT (.vtt), and plain-text-with-timestamps formats. Transcript URLs include a signed token (?t=) issued per feed fetch — pull them fresh from the current RSS rather than caching long-term.

podcasts.title: BrainStuff
podcasts.description: Short (5-10 min) single-host explainer episodes answering everyday how/why questions.
podcasts.difficultyNotes: Solo scripted narration, deliberate pace, short episode length keeps cognitive load low.

podcasts.title: TechStuff
podcasts.description: Host-led explainers on how technology works and the stories behind it.
podcasts.difficultyNotes: Primarily solo narration with a scripted, explainer structure; technical terms are defined as introduced.

podcasts.title: Atlanta Monster
podcasts.description: Documentary-style true crime narrated by a single host, woven with archival and interview audio.
podcasts.difficultyNotes: Produced, scripted narration at a deliberate documentary pace, similar in structure to This American Life but single-voice-led.
podcasts.transcriptCoverageNote: Feed-wide transcript tag count is much lower than the other shows here, suggesting only part of the back catalog has transcripts rather than every episode — verify per-episode before ingesting.

podcasts.title: Stuff You Should Know
podcasts.description: Josh and Chuck riff on a wide range of topics with genuine banter and tangents.
podcasts.difficultyNotes: Faster, more idiomatic than a scripted show; frequent tangents and asides.

podcasts.title: Stuff You Missed in History Class
podcasts.description: Two hosts present scripted deep dives into historical events and figures, alternating narration.
podcasts.difficultyNotes: More scripted than most two-host shows, but still natural conversational pace and occasional tangents.

podcasts.title: Part-Time Genius
podcasts.description: Two hosts explore trivia-driven topics with comedic banter.
podcasts.difficultyNotes: Conversational pace with wordplay and jokes, but topic-focused structure keeps it more predictable than a free-form chat show.

podcasts.title: This Podcast Will Kill You
podcasts.description: Two epidemiologists discuss the history and science of diseases in a conversational format.
podcasts.difficultyNotes: Natural conversational pace with tangents; some domain-specific medical/scientific vocabulary balanced by explanation.

podcasts.title: My Favorite Murder
podcasts.description: Karen Kilgariff and Georgia Hardstark discuss true crime stories in a casual comedic format.
podcasts.difficultyNotes: Fast, overlapping speech, tangents, heavy colloquialism and slang.

podcasts.title: The Daily Zeitgeist
podcasts.description: Two hosts plus a rotating guest riff on daily news and pop culture.
podcasts.difficultyNotes: Fast-paced, heavy current pop-culture references and slang, frequent crosstalk between three or more voices.

podcasts.title: The Bechdel Cast
podcasts.description: Two hosts plus a rotating guest analyze movies through a feminist lens.
podcasts.difficultyNotes: Fast comedic banter, heavy pop-culture/internet slang, three-way crosstalk.

podcasts.title: Stuff They Don't Want You To Know
podcasts.description: Hosts discuss conspiracy theories and unexplained phenomena in an unscripted, fast-moving conversational format.
podcasts.difficultyNotes: Fast, loosely structured conversation with frequent asides, sarcasm, and internet-culture references.
